answer: In a canyon microgrid fed by the Zephyr wind farm and serving a reef lab, reward measured demand cuts. A utility signs each meter interval, verified kWh saved and claimant key. The ledger counts an interval once and divides a fixed pool by verified kWh, with no signup award. Parallel aliases and colluders cannot multiply the same cut; more weight costs additional foregone power use. This assumes honest meters and baselines set before events to prevent inflated claims. Newcomers can enroll a small metered load.
